title: Patch: a Main menu button on every end-of-game screen
thread:
**Issue #4742 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4742: Patch: a Main menu button on every end-of-game screen
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Going back to the menu is the button players click most once a game ends, yet most of the client's end-of-game screens don't have one. An audit of `apps/web/src` found only the online match (`routes/match.tsx`, "Back to the lobby") and the dev hotseat put a way back on the result itself. This adds a **Main menu** button to the result of every mode that lacks one.

#### Screens with no menu button (must fix)

| Screen | What it offers now | How to reach the menu today |
|---|---|---|
| Practice vs AI: `practice/PracticeResult.tsx` (`actions`, ~line 134) | Play again, Change setup, Watch the replay, Share the last turn, View the board | The board's Menu control (`routes/practice.tsx` `menuButtons`, ~line 1086) sits under the modal dialog: View the board, then Menu, 2 clicks |
| Tutorial lesson: `tutorial/TutorialResult.tsx` (`actions`, ~line 187) | Next lesson / Retry / Play a practice game, Back to lessons | None. A lesson gets no `controlExtras` (`practice.tsx` ~line 1130), so the board has no Menu control either |
| Dungeon run over: `dungeon/map/RunOverScreen.tsx` (`.dungeon-run-actions`, ~line 124) | Start a new run, Statistics | Only the corner `BackLink` at the top of `RunScreen.tsx` (~line 123), usually scrolled off above the long stats list |

#### Menu only on the board behind the result (should fix)

| Screen | Result panel | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Dungeon fight: `dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx` `resultActions` (~line 265) | Continue / Retry | The board's Main menu control still takes clicks through `.result-scrim` (`pointer-events: none`), but the panel itself offers none |
| Infinite Assault fight: `assault/fight/FightScreen.tsx` `resultActions` (~line 266) | Continue / Retry | Same as the dungeon fight |

Continue stays the primary action on both. Main menu goes after it, and must not discard the run or the day's attempt in a way the existing board Main menu control doesn't (it's already allowed once the fight has its result: R3932000, R4582001).

#### Out to the mode's hub only (nice to have)

Daily game (`daily/DailyBoard.tsx`, "Back to daily games") and Duos (`duos/DuosBoard.tsx`, "Back to Play together") each exit to their own hub. Add Main menu beside the hub button. The watch route (`together/WatchRoute.tsx`) and the assault day result screens (`assault/day/ResultScreens.tsx`, which already have a corner arrow to Play) are fine as they are.

#### Where it goes

- Where a route already has a menu handler, the new button reuses it, so the two never disagree. Practice and the tutorial reuse `onMenu` in `routes/practice.tsx`, which also clears the practice resume. The dungeon and assault fights reuse their board `menuButton`'s handler.
- Everywhere else it goes to `paths.play`, as the match's "Back to the lobby" and the mode screens' `BackLink`s do.
- Known mismatch, **out of scope here**: practice's `onMenu` goes to `paths.landing` (`/`), while the match, dungeon and assault go to `paths.play` (`/play`). Don't change practice's destination in this issue. Mention it in the PR so a person can decide.

Prefer one small shared button (one label, `t("Main menu")`, already in the i18n catalogs) over a hand-written copy on each screen. Each one gets its own `data-testid`, per the screen's testid module.

### Acceptance

- [ ] The practice result dialog has a Main menu action that leaves in one click and does what the board's Menu control does on a finished game (unit test in the practice route's tests).
- [ ] The tutorial result dialog has a Main menu action that leaves the lesson (unit test).
- [ ] The dungeon run-over screen has a Main menu button in `.dungeon-run-actions` that goes to `paths.play` (unit test).
- [ ] The dungeon fight and assault fight result panels have a Main menu button after Continue that does what their board Main menu control does once the fight is over (unit tests).
- [ ] Daily and Duos results show Main menu beside their hub button (unit tests), or the PR says why not.
- [ ] Practice's result still focuses Play again first, and the 1v1 panel's first-action focus (`Result.tsx`) is unchanged.
- [ ] e2e specs that list or count a result's buttons are updated. `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `typecheck` and eslint are green.

### Blocked by, part of

None.
```
